«It sounds like the ''Bellicose'' was able to intervene before things got out of hand.|Patriarch Clarr'ivl'exow and Captain Clarr'os'culry|audio=Ersikarosbellicose.flac||translated=1}} In [[18 BBY]], during a [[Grysk plot to engineer a Chiss civil war|crisis]] in the [[Chiss Ascendancy]] nation, the '''battle at Csaus''' was fought between armed [[freighter]]s of the Ascendancy's [[Tahmie]] and [[Droc family|Droc]] [[Great Families|families]] at the Chiss [[Unknown Regions]] astronomical object [[Csaus]]. The freighters exchanged several [[spectrum laser]] shots before [[Chiss Defense Force]] [[Admiral]] [[Ers'ikaro]]'s [[Firewolf man-of-war]] [[Bellicose (Firewolf man-of-war)|''Bellicose'']] stopped the battle in order to prevent further escalation of the crisis. [[Clarr family]] [[Patriarch]] [[Clarr'ivl'exow]] later asked Clarr [[Captain]] [[Clarr'os'culry]]—who considered the battle at Csaus to have been smaller than a skirmish—if she had heard about the engagement, which the [[officer]] confirmed. Shortly thereafter, the Tahmie and Droc [[Skirmish at Jamiron|resumed]] their hostilities on the [[planet]]''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Chaos Rising]]'' [[Jamiron]]. ==Behind the scenes== The battle at Csaus was mentioned in the [[2021]] novel ''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Lesser Evil]]'', the final installment in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[Star Wars: The Ascendancy Trilogy|''Thrawn Ascendancy Trilogy'']]. ==Appearances== *''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Lesser Evil]]'' {{Ab|Thrawn Ascendancy: Lesser Evil (audiobook)}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{GryskConquestsNav}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Csaus, battle at}} [[Category:Battles of Csaus]] [[Category:Battles of the Grysk plot to engineer a Chiss civil war]]
